column1: # Curated MAC prefix overrides. Hand-maintained; wins over the IEEE table.
# Two things the IEEE registry cannot tell you, both of which matter more to an
# operator than the registered company name:
#   1. Prefixes IEEE never assigned. QEMU/KVM's 52:54:00 and VirtualBox's
#      host-only 0A:00:27 are locally administered — the registry has no row at
#      all, so without this file they resolve to nothing.
#   2. Prefixes where the registered owner is not the useful answer. 08:00:27 is
#      registered to "PCS Systemtechnik", an Oracle subsidiary. Nobody looking at
#      an inventory wants that; they want "VirtualBox".
# Prefixes are uppercase hex with no separators, any even length. Longest match
# wins, and any entry here beats the IEEE table at any length.
